about_the_game:
"QuestionBank" is a trivia game where you get one free quiz attempt every day. Each time you answer a question correctly, you consume one attempt and earn a unique "Cat Coin." Answering 30 questions correctly in a row will unlock the legendary "Golden Scroll," but there are only 1 million attempts available in total. By continuously answering questions, you not only test your knowledge and challenge your limits, but also compete with players worldwide! With every correct answer, you're one step closer to claiming the title of Quiz Champion!

The 1 million+ question database covers everything from simple arithmetic to the creator's wildest ideas. With daily non-intelligent recommendations, it adapts to a brainpower marathon for players of all ages!

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: win7/win10
  • Processor: intel Core i5-6400 or AMD FX 8320
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 or AMD Radeon R9 280
  • DirectX: Version 11
